findings.description: Saving a new expense once (a single POST /expenses, 303 response) stores two identical records: the list shows the expense twice and the total rises by twice the amount (adding 'Dupe probe', office, $5.00 raised the total by $10.00). Every create I tried produced a duplicate, and deleting one copy leaves the other.
repro: Enter title 'Dupe probe', category office, amount 5.00
Open /expenses: 'Dupe probe office $5.00' appears twice and the Total increases by $10.00

findings.description: Expense titles are inserted into the expenses table as raw HTML, not escaped. A title such as 'BOLDTEXT' is rendered as bold markup in the list for every signed-in user (including viewers), so a stored title can inject markup into other users' pages and break table rows. Script execution was not confirmed because titles are cut to 20 characters (see f3).
repro: Open /expenses/new, enter title 'BOLDTEXT', category office, amount 2.00, click Save expense
Sign in as viewer-bcea and open /expenses
The title cell contains a real element (cell innerHTML is 'BOLDTEXT') instead of the literal text
Edit form for the same record shows the raw string 'BOLDTEXT', so the list is not escaping it

findings.description: Expense titles are silently truncated to 20 characters on both create and edit. The form has no maxlength and shows no warning, so 'New expense with a long title 0123456789' is saved as 'New expense with a l' and 'Edited title that is quite long 0123456789' as 'Edited title that is'.
repro: Open /expenses/new and enter the title 'New expense with a long title 0123456789', category office, amount 3.00
The list shows 'New expense with a l' with no warning; opening Edit shows the truncated 20-character title

notes: Time budget ~10 min. Testing created many junk expense records in the shared instance (QA add test, Dupe probe, Zero test, Big test, Ital, Longxxx, QA3 and others) and changed Notebooks to 'Notebooks (renamed)' / 13.00 and Team lunch to 70.00; the injected titles also broke some rows in the list. Verified OK: viewer and editor see identical totals; category filter sums correct; viewer gets 403 on /expenses/new, /expenses/N/edit, POST /expenses, POST /expenses/N and POST /expenses/N/delete; anonymous access redirects to /login; logout invalidates the session cookie; login error message is shown; edit form values match list rows; a delete removes only one row; server rejects negative, empty, non-numeric and unknown-category values on edit. Not tested: load under concurrency, accessibility tooling (axe), and mobile layout.
